name: RC-B10-0328/2025 – Motion for a resolution
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Ryan Cornelius in Dubai
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the release of Ryan Cornelius, a 71-year-old British man held in Dubai since 2008. It says his detention is arbitrary and breaks international law. It asks Dubai to free him, give him medical care, pay him compensation and investigate his case. It also asks the United Kingdom and European Union officials to push for his release. The Parliament cannot order his release itself; it is stating its position and making requests.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament is asking Dubai and the UK to act.
- **Who it affects:** Ryan Cornelius, his family, and United Arab Emirates and United Kingdom authorities.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to European Union bodies and the UK and United Arab Emirates governments.
